profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Infrastructure, and MLOps. Spearheading the ongoing development of a scalable ETL pipeline and Machine Learning Ops platform, achieving a 40% reduction in data costs and a 50% improvement in ML feature time-to-release. Always tackling new challenges to drive data-driven solutions through expertise in Python, SQL, and ETL processes.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
PMG is a global independent marketing services and technology company that seeks to inspire people and brands that anything is possible.
Momentum Commerce was acquired by PMG in June 2025.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · SQL · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Warehousing · Data Quality Control · Software Infrastructure · Data Science · Software Development

positions.title: Analytics Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Data Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built Data Simulator that models customer behavior and understands 93% of customer searches, allowing us to better understand lower traffic areas of the website
- Wrote the Search-wide AB Test analysis script that supports analysis of dynamic input data
- Created Python3 data pipeline for the Search Suggestions team, from data collection to preprocessing/filtering and analysis
- Python, C# (.NET), C++, JS, Cypher, SQL

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
- Created front and backend logic that allows customers to search and filter through previous orders and saved products
- Improved time to success by 25% by redesigning content pages to more concisely and intelligently present filtering and product family options
- Implemented RESTful APIs on our app that increased functionality to match and exceed the website through Mobile specific features
- Swift, ObjC, Visual Basic, C#

positions.title: Secretary General
positions.locationName: Washington University Model United Nations Conference
positions.description:
- Served as Chief Executive of WUMUNC, a Model UN conference hosting more than 250 students from across the country
- Formalized framework for future conferences by negotiating hotel contracts, building relationships with outside universities and sponsors, securing locations for conference and events, and expanding the conference 25%
- Served for three years on the Executive Board of the conference- previously as the Deputy Secretary-General and the year before as the Under-Secretary-General of Operations.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Teaching assistant for Internet of Things and Computer Science 2 at Washington University in St. Louis, a class teaching HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Java, and Arduino C
- Held office hours and assisted during class sessions with code, lectures, grading, and Arduino configurations
- Led students through distributed systems assignments that fuse mobile phone applications, websites, and Arduino hardware

positions.title: Global Treasury Management Intern
positions.description:
- Worked as Project Manager and Business Analyst with U.S. Bank’s largest customer (U.S. Treasury Department) on implementing U.S. Bank as the sole financial agent for all federal non-tax lock-boxes.
- Analyzed cash flows greater than $10 million with $43.7 million in projected revenue.
- Created and presented meetings to project stakeholders including the U.S. Treasury Department.

positions.title: Vice President of Public Relations, Junior Class Council
positions.description:
- Created visuals to promote 10 events, each attended by 50-100 members of the Junior Class, and communicated with all outside organizations involved in the planning process.
- Worked with 4 other members of the Council to program, advertise and execute these events.

company.name: Washington University in St. Louis Student Union

positions.title: Junior Political Writer
positions.description:
-Worked with a team of 5 other interns to perform political analysis and political writing for Whipboard, a data-driven political publication that uses data analytics to provide insights into American politics.
-Wrote a series of articles on political and economic issues, many of which pertained to local, state, and federal elections, including the presidential election.
-Utilized the FiscalNote legislative analysis platform to perform original research and write political articles.
-Served as content manager for the site by syndicating articles, posting on social media and working with other organizations to perform research for Whipboard.

projects.title: Face Mask Detection and Recognition in Multi-Face Images
projects.description:
- Created a model based on VGGNet, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), to classify faces based on the presence of face masks
- Used a modified Haar Cascade logic to find faces in real world images
- Validation accuracy of 99.15% of model on input images
- Located faces and classifies faces in usable interface

projects.title: FIFA Player Analysis
projects.description:
- This project analyzed players' attributes and position for every player registered in FIFA 2019 using multivariate analysis. 
- Principal component analysis (PCA) was used for dimensionality reduction and interpretation. The PCA categorized the variables into five components (Attacking, Defending, Hype&Value, Players Physique, and Others). 
- Exploratory factor analysis (EFA) was used to understand the relationship between players' reputations and compensation. EFA proposed that reputation and compensation are somewhat related but not linearly.
- Canonical correspondence analysis (CCA) was used to determine the association between a player’s skills, attributes, and the position ratings. CCA proposed that a player’s skills are indeed associated with their position rating and vice-versa.
